subject: Life Skills

source.topic: Personal and Social Well-being: Healthy habits
source.subtopic: Proper use of the toilet and toilet routine; regular exercise and play; limited television

show.line: Use the toilet, flush, and wash your hands. Then go and play!

rounds.prompt: Use the toilet, flush, and then?
Which picture shows the toilet left clean?
Name a game that keeps you fit.
We wash our hands with soap and...?

hints: Play every day to keep fit.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I used the toilet.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Now I go straight to eat lunch!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! First I wash my hands.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Toilet, flush, wash hands. Then lunch!

parent_line: Knows the toilet routine and that regular play keeps us healthy.
